title: Genesis 2:1-3 — God completes His work and rests on the seventh day
summary: Genesis 2:1-3 in English: the heavens and earth are completed, God finishes His work, rests on the seventh day, blesses and sanctifies it. The word "God" is shown in blue, red and gold and "created" in red and tan.

text.text: 1 Thus the heavens and the earth were completed, and all their hosts.
2 By the seventh day God completed His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.
3 And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He rested from all His work which God had created to do.
